LESSON: WRITING 1.4.1 FUNCTIONAL WRITING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.4: Writing 1.4.1 Functional writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Writing 1.4.1 Functional writing. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should one be careful when filling in forms? 2. What information do we fill in forms?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the required information to be filled in forms for different purposes,
2. fill information in forms correctly for self- expression,
3. realise the importance of filling forms correctly for effective communication. SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.
